display_name: Phase1 合法有标签源集的基座与恢复判断诊断
description: 仅使用 L_s 合法训练标签，比较 clean 基座与冻结 DURA 恢复后基座判断，核实物理 ID 对齐。
authorization: 用户要求研发更强星地恢复网络并严格限定 Phase1 地面训练、测试与 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 基座。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch CPU only, original Phase1 frozen Tri-SIG-TIME release

data.representation: Phase1 L_s ground source clean/received IQ and legal source L_s labels
data.label_map_ref: Phase1 six TX classes; hidden throughout restorer training
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.actual_training_labels: Exactly 6300 legal L_s labels; no U_s labels, V or test IQ

permissions.regime: Phase1 labeled L_s source only, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL and DURA
permissions.query_use: No U_s labels, V or test access
permissions.claim_scope: Labeled training-source diagnosis only, no independent test claim

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original DURA E20 and original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: L_s ID joins across metadata, source IQ storage and R07; clean IQ allclose; six class labels
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Exact source-only frozen models and authorized L_s ground labels

execution.stop_rule: Mismatch in physical IDs, class labels, source IQ or frozen state stops and preserves log

metric_names: clean teacher and DURA correct counts versus labeled L_s
metrics_plan.targets_ref: legal L_s labels, not target test truth

notes: 只读取 Phase1 合法有标签 L_s 的 6300 个训练标签；绝不读取 U_s 标签、V 或测试数据；两个源视图共用同一批物理 ID。
源标签 metadata 顺序、DURA 源 IQ 顺序及底层 F IQ 存储顺序不同，按物理 ID 重排，核对 6300 个 ID、clean IQ 在 rtol 1e-5 atol 1e-6 下匹配，检查标签值 0 至 5。
固定 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 和原 DURA；统计 source clean 与 DURA 的训练标签正确数、两者不同意时各自正确数，按源场景及状态分组。
有标签数据是训练集，不是独立测试；不改变当前已登记且运行中的无 TX 标签学生训练。该诊断不读取目标或测试 IQ，结果不能作为未见数据性能。

rows.method: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME and DURA source-label comparison
rows.purpose: Determine whether clean pseudo-labels are reliable where DURA and clean teacher disagree
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source rows and views; deterministic fixed model
rows.budget_ref: 6300 unique L_s IDs, clean once plus 2 source views, no model updates
